reviews.title: A really great buy for your gaming needs!
reviews.comment: My particular* (really picky) twelve year old loves it! Great quality and the lights in the back are super cool!
reviews.author: Lexi

reviews.title: Good budget monitor
reviews.comment: If this is what a $100 monitor is like, I wonder what $200+ more is. 240hz, very crisp and no complaints. Noticed slight ghosting when connected to Xbox but on my pc, it was perfect. Speakers are about 6.5/10 though, but they work and are something most can probably deal with.
reviews.author: Pierre Sanders

reviews.title: Excellent gaming monitor especially for the price point
reviews.comment: Excellent monitor especially for the price. Very impressed, it came on time in good packaging!
reviews.author: David

reviews.title: Very big, not very adjustable but decent
reviews.comment: Monitor was way bigger than I expected but the visuals are very crispy and smooth. Came with 240hz as advertised and works just fine with my 2.1 hdmi gaming laptop. My only issue is that my desk is a bit low and that I can’t adjust the monitor to face upwards as much as I want but the size makes up for this and I can still see fine. It came with a hdmi cable but I used a seperately bought one anyways.
reviews.author: napkinbusiness
